paper_info.title: Retrieval-augmented generation for large language models: A survey
paper_info.authors: Y Gao, Y Xiong, X Gao, K Jia, J Pan, Y Bi, Y Dai
paper_info.paper_abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) showcase impres- sive capabilities but encounter challenges like hallucination, outdated knowledge, and non-transparent, untraceable reasoning processes. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a promising solution by incorporating knowledge from external databases. This enhances the accuracy and credibility of the generation, particularly for knowledge-intensive tasks, and allows for continuous knowledge updates and integration of domain- specific information. RAG synergistically merges LLMs’ intrin- sic knowledge with the vast, dynamic repositories of external databases. This comprehensive review paper offers a detailed examination of the progression of RAG paradigms, encompassing the Naive RAG, the Advanced RAG, and the Modular RAG. It meticulously scrutinizes the tripartite foundation of RAG frameworks, which includes the retrieval, the generation and the augmentation techniques. The paper highlights the state-of-the- art technologies embedded in each of these critical components, providing a profound understanding of the advancements in RAG systems. Furthermore, this paper introduces up-to-date evalua- tion framework and benchmark. At the end, this article delineates the challenges currently faced and points out prospective avenues for research and development 1.
paper_info.ai_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）虽能力强大，但仍面临幻觉、知识过时和推理过程不透明等问题。检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）通过引入外部数据库知识，有效提升了生成内容的准确性与可信度，尤其适用于知识密集型任务，并支持持续知识更新与领域信息融合。本文对RAG技术进行了系统性综述，梳理了其三大范式演进：朴素RAG（Naive RAG）、高级RAG（Advanced RAG）和模块化RAG（Modular RAG）。文章深入剖析了RAG框架的三大核心组成部分——检索、生成与增强，详细评述了各环节的前沿技术。此外，论文总结了当前RAG的评估体系，涵盖26项下游任务、近50个数据集、主流评测指标与基准工具，并指出了RAG当前面临的挑战与未来研究方向。本综述旨在为研究人员和从业者提供对RAG技术全景式的理解。

paper_info.title: Crud-rag: A comprehensive chinese benchmark for retrieval-augmented generation of large language models
paper_info.authors: Y Lyu, Z Li, S Niu, F Xiong, B Tang, W Wang
paper_info.ai_abstract: 本文针对现有检索增强生成（RAG）评估基准主要局限于问答任务、忽视其他应用场景及系统组件全面评估的问题，提出了CRUD-RAG——一个面向中文的综合性大规模RAG评测基准。该基准基于用户与知识库交互的CRUD（Create, Read, Update, Delete）四类操作，构建了对应四个应用场景的评估任务：文本续写（Create）、问答（Read）、幻觉修正（Update）和多文档摘要（Delete）。数据集基于中国主流新闻网站最新高质量新闻数据，并利用GPT-4自动构建，旨在减少大语言模型在训练中接触测试数据的可能性。论文在该基准上对RAG系统的多个关键组件（如检索器、上下文长度、知识库构建方式和大语言模型）进行了系统性实验评估，并为不同场景下优化RAG系统提供了实用建议。本研究的主要贡献包括：一个覆盖CRUD四类场景的综合评测基准、高质量多样化的中文评估数据集，以及广泛的实验分析和实践指导。

paper_info.title: Evaluation of retrieval-augmented generation: A survey
paper_info.authors: H Yu, A Gan, K Zhang, S Tong, Q Liu, Z Liu
paper_info.paper_abstract: . Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has recently gained traction in natural language processing. Numerous studies and real-world applications are leveraging its ability to enhance generative models through external informa- tion retrieval. Evaluating these RAG systems, however, poses unique challenges due to their hybrid structure and reliance on dynamic knowledge sources. To better understand these challenges, we conduct A Unified Evaluation Process of RAG (Auepora) and aim to provide a comprehensive overview of the evaluation and benchmarks of RAG systems. Specifically, we examine and compare several quantifiable metrics of the Retrieval and Generation components, such as rele- vance, accuracy, and faithfulness, within the current RAG benchmarks, encom- passing the possible output and ground truth pairs. We then analyze the various datasets and metrics, discuss the limitations of current benchmarks, and suggest potential directions to advance the field of RAG benchmarks.
paper_info.ai_abstract: 本文对检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）系统的评估方法进行了系统性综述。由于RAG结合了检索与生成两个模块，并依赖动态外部知识源，其评估面临独特挑战。作者提出了一个统一的RAG评估流程（Auepora），从“评估目标”、“数据集”和“评估指标”三个维度出发，对现有RAG评估框架进行梳理与分析。文章详细比较了针对检索模块（如相关性、召回率）、生成模块（如忠实性、准确性）以及整体系统性能的多种量化指标，总结了当前主流基准测试所使用的数据集与评价方法，并指出了现有评估体系在覆盖范围、任务适配性和动态知识处理等方面的局限性。最后，论文提出了未来RAG评估研究的改进方向，旨在推动更全面、鲁棒和实用的评估标准发展。
